programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: The Hard Corps
programme.desc: Quand Wayne Barclay a témoigné contre le poids lourd de l’industrie musicale Terrell Singletery, il s’est fait un ennemi à vie. Terrel vient d’être libéré de prison et le temps qu’il a passé derrière les barreaux n’a fait qu’alimenter sa soif de vengeance, ce qui ne sera pas facile pour cet ancien détenu aigri. Lorsque Philip Sauvage forme une unité spéciale de baroudeurs et d’anciens soldats pour protéger Barclay, le voyou déterminé est forcé de se battre contre une équipe de combattants suffisamment expérimentés pour mener une petite guerre.

programme.title: Profession Tueur 2
programme.desc: Notre tueur professionnel est de retour et, cette fois, il va devoir affronter les meilleurs assassins du monde pour protéger le fils ingrat d'un parrain de la mafia, sauver la vie de son seul et unique ami et espérer renouer avec son père un peu détraqué.

programme.title: Souviens Toi L'ete Dernier
programme.desc: La nuit de la fête nationale, Julie, Helen, Ray et Barry ont par accident renversé un inconnu. Devant la crainte de leur avenir compromis par ce drame, ils décident de faire disparaître le corps et font le serment de ne rien dire à personne, jamais. L'été suivant, chacun des quatre amis se trouve confronté à des évenements terrifiants. Ils doivent se rendre à l'évidence : quelqu'un sait ce qu'ils ont fait et semble bien decidé à le leur faire payer.

programme.title: Spider-Man : New Generation
programme.desc: Spider-Man traverse les dimensions et fait équipe avec ses autres versions.

programme.title: Les Aventures De Tintin : Le Secret De La Licorne
programme.desc: manifestement la convoitise de nombreux amateurs, qui pressent le petit reporter de le leur céder. Parmi eux, le propriétaire du château de Moulinsart, Sakharine. L'appartement de Tintin est visité par des inconnus. Le jeune reporter se rend alors à Moulinsart. Une autre maquette de La Licorne s'y trouve. Puis, chez lui, Tintin met la main sur un parchemin, tombé de la maquette brisée. Lancé sur la piste d'un trésor caché, il est enlevé et séquestré dans la cabine d'un cargo, le Karaboudjan. Il y fait la connaissance d'un ivrogne haut en couleur, le capitaine Haddock...

programme.title: The Walk
programme.desc: Douze personnes ont marché sur la lune. Un seul homme aura marché au-dessus du vide vertigineux séparant les deux tours du World Trade Center. Le funambule Philippe Petit, avec l'aide de son mentor, Papa Rudy, et d'une bande de passionnés de tous horizons, va surmonter les pires obstacles, vaincre les trahisons, les dissensions, et prendre les risques les plus insensés pour exécuter le plus fou de tous les paris : passer d'une tour à l'autre du World Trade Center en marchant sur un fil tendu au-dessus du vide …

programme.title: Spider-Man : New Generation
programme.desc: Spider-Man traverse les dimensions et fait équipe avec ses autres versions.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Né dans les flammes de l'enfer, le démon Hellboy est transporté sur Terre lors d'une sombre cérémonie célébrée par les nazis, désireux d'utiliser les forces infernales à des fins de conquête. Sauvé par le docteur Broom, Hellboy est alors élevé pour combattre les forces du Mal.

programme.title: Xxx Triple X
programme.desc: Après une série de tests, Xander 'XXX' Cage, un spécialiste des sports extrêmes couvert de tatouages, est recruté par Augustus Gibbons, un agent de la NSA, pour s'infiltrer dans une organisation criminelle et mettre fin à ses agissements. Dirigée par un certain Yorgi, celle-ci se fait appeler 'Anarchie 99' et son siège se situe à Prague, en République tchèque.

programme.title: Plus Jamais
programme.desc: Slim, une jeune serveuse, a toujours eu du mal à joindre les deux bouts, jusqu'à ce qu'elle épouse Mitch, un riche entrepreneur. Celle-ci vit dorénavant un conte de fée avec sa fille et son mari. Mais, la vraie nature de Mitch se révèle. Slim va tout faire alors pour ne plus subir en tant que victime mais va agir pour être à présent l'adversaire.

programme.title: Middleman
programme.desc: Trois intrigues convergentes racontent l’histoire de contrebandiers, d'un tueur en série et de trafiquants de drogue. Un ancien trafiquant (Snipes) essaie de se ranger mais il tombe sur une cachette contenant des drogues volées. Dans le même temps, une banlieusarde d’âge moyen (Cybill Shepherd) cache un tempérament sadique et vicieux.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Carl Casper, Chef cuisinier, préfère démissionner soudainement de son poste plutôt que d'accepter de compromettre son intégrité créative par les décisions du propriétaire de l'établissement. Il doit alors décider de son avenir. Se retrouvant ainsi à Miami, il s'associe à son ex-femme, son ami et son fils pour lancer un food truck. En prenant la route, le Chef Carl retourne à ses racines et retrouve la passion pour la cuisine et un zeste de vie et d'amour.

programme.title: Big Party
programme.desc: A leur soirée de fin d'année, des étudiants se retrouvent pour une grande fête, parler de leur avenir et tenter de s'éloigner le plus possible de la vie sage et routinière qu'ils avaient été obligés de suivre jusqu'à présent.

programme.title: Coup de foudre et conséquences
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie romantique, Matthew Perry (Chandler de la série télé 'Friends') est Alex Whitman, un New-yorkais envoyé à Las Vegas pour superviser un projet de construction. Il y rencontre Isabel Fuentes (Salma Hayek, Desperado), et une attraction certaine les réunit le temps d'une nuit. Mais Alex ne revoit Isabel que trois mois après, quand elle lui apprend qu'elle est enceinte. Sur un coup de tête, il la demande en mariage. Mais Alex et Isabel découvrent très vite qu'un mariage ne se résume pas qu'à une chapelle à Las Vegas et un imitateur d'Elvis.

programme.title: L'an 1 : Des Debuts Difficiles
programme.desc: Deux "chasseurs-cueilleurs" feignants sont bannis de leur village natal. Ils se lancent alors dans une odyssée à travers un monde primitif.

programme.title: Le Temoin Amoureux
programme.desc: Tom et Claire sont amis depuis une dizaine d'années. Lorsque cette dernière lui demande d'être son garçon d'honneur, il s'aperçoit qu'il est en fait amoureux d'elle. Il accepte cependant sa proposition avec l'espoir secret de pouvoir la conquérir.

programme.title: Coup de foudre et conséquences

programme.title: Le Temoin Amoureux
programme.desc: Tom et Claire sont amis depuis une dizaine d'années. Lorsque cette dernière lui demande d'être son garçon d'honneur, il s'aperçoit qu'il est en fait amoureux d'elle. Il accepte cependant sa proposition avec l'espoir secret de pouvoir la conquérir.

programme.title: CLICK : télécommandez votre vie
programme.desc: Michael Newman (Adam Sandler) est marié à la belle Donna (Kate Beckinsale) ; ils ont deux adorables enfants, qu' il ne voit pas beaucoup parce qu'il passe trop de temps à son cabinet d'architecte.

programme.title: Couple de Stars
programme.desc: Kiki est l'assistante dévouée de la belle et égocentrique star de cinéma Gwen Harrison, qui n'est autre que sa sœur. Ce qui est le plus dur, ce n'est pas de supporter les mille et un caprices de madame la grande actrice, c'est d'être secrètement amoureuse de son futur ex-mari, l'irrésistible Eddie, lui aussi acteur.

programme.title: Mariage Explosif
programme.desc: Les membres d'une famille se confrontent à ce qui les déchire lors du mariage du fils aîné.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry et Elaine doutent du fait que le yaourt de Kramer soit vraiment "sans matière grasse".

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry meurt d'envie que sa nouvelle petite amie lui fasse un massage. Elaine est inquiète au sujet du nom de son nouveau petit ami.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Winona, l'amie amérindienne d'Elaine, trouve que Jerry est à la limite du racisme quand il offre la statue d'un Indien stéréotypé à Elaine pour se faire pardonner de ne pas l'avoir raccompagnée de chez George.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Par amour, George commence un processus de conversion à la religion orthodoxe lettone.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry et George évitent de justesse de se faire lapider en public après que George a garé la voiture de son père sur une place réservée aux handicapés, ce qui incite une foule en colère à saccager le véhicule lorsqu'une femme handicapée est blessée suite à ce stationnement illégal. Alors que le père de George, qui ne se doute de rien, est arrêté par erreur pour ce délit, George et Kramer achètent un fauteuil roulant électrique pour l'offrir à la victime.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: L'intérêt d'Elaine pour un de ses anciens petits amis est ravivé lorsque ce dernier perd du poids.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: L'odeur corporelle d'un portier hante Jerry et Elaine. George découvre des nouvelles surprenantes au sujet de Susan.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry, l'épisode pilote de la série télévisée, est distribué et enfin diffusé. Elaine tente de freiner les ardeurs romantiques de Dalrymple.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: L'épisode pilote de la série de Jerry et George est enfin produit par la chaîne.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry découvre un secret gênant au sujet de son idylle avec Elaine.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Grandir dans les années 80 au sein d'une famille complétement barrée mais aimante, c'était le quotidien d'Adam, aujourd'hui trentenaire, qui se demande comment il a pu devenir si 'normal' dans de telles conditions ! A partir des vidéos qu'il a tournées pendant toute son enfance, il en retrace les événéments les plus marquants.

programme.title: Art Of Falling In Love
programme.desc: An artist painting a mural on a new hospital wing falls for the project's architect but worries he may not want to be with her if she reveals the unfortunate story behind her secret bucket list.

programme.title: Beauty and the Billionaire: Bali
programme.desc: American doctor Ivy Miller lives in Bali, working at a charitable health clinic. When a billionaire benefactor named Dylan Donnelly arrives, Ivy is less than impressed. He is only interested in making himself look better by appearing charitable. Ivy is happy when he goes on his way, but then an accident injures one of Dylan’s trusted advisors, Blake. Dylan insists Ivy stay at Dylan’s lavish estate in Bali to care for Blake until he’s well.

programme.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programme.desc: Preparing for the annual Masters of Chocolate Festival, Aria's plans get rattled when she loses her partner shortly before the competition. However, a dashing single father soon steps in to help Aria find the winning ingredient.

programme.title: Horse Crazy Too
programme.desc: When a prize foal is stolen, two young siblings and their teenage babysitter must work together and catch the thieves before their family's ranch goes into foreclosure. A dangerous journey lies ahead, but with a little mountain magic, sometimes it pays to horse around!

programme.title: The Confession
programme.desc: All her life, Katie Lapp has known no other world than that of the Amish family who raised her. But upon discovering that she was actually adopted from out of the "English" world, her quest for answers to her identity resulted in her being shunned by her people. Now in "The Confession," the thrilling sequel to "The Shunning," Katie is on an even greater quest--to be reunited before it is too late with her long-lost birth mother, Laura Mayfield, who is dying of cancer. Only the challenges of being Amish in an English world stand in her way... along with one man who has other plans for her biological mother's legacy.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: Wedding photographer Jessie Brooke's happy small-town life is turned upside-down when a famous Hollywood actor shows up at her parents' lakeside vineyard for his sister's wedding.

programme.title: A Royal Surprise
programme.desc: When Riley's boyfriend, Mandla, invites her to South Africa to meet his family, she is shocked to discover that he is a prince. The news puts Riley's trust in Mandla in jeopardy, and he must do what he can to win her love back.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Passport to Love
programme.desc: Nicole, a successful travel blogger, meets Kade, a marketing rep for a travel publishing company, and they form the beginnings of a relationship while exploring an island destination. They juggle their work traveling around the world while seeing each other again. Both know there’s something special between them, but it will be put to the test when Kade’s competitive boss challenges Kade to thwart Nicole’s business.

programme.title: Belle and the Beast

Now in "The Confession," the thrilling sequel to "The Shunning," Katie is on an even greater quest--to be reunited before it is too late with her long-lost birth mother, Laura Mayfield, who is dying of cancer. Only the challenges of being Amish in an English world stand in her way... along with one man who has other plans for her biological mother's legacy.

She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Tasting Hokkaido's Secret Food Scene & Exploring Japan’s Snow Capital | DIRT Japan: Hokkaido"
programme.desc: In our final episode in Japan, the DIRT team went road-tripping through beautiful, snowy Japanese landscapes—and tasting everything in sight. A crown jewel in the northeast corner of Japan, Hokkaido may be famous among skiers and snowboarders for the luscious "Japow," but way beyond the tourist trail there's a burgeoning new food scene and a unique and vibrant history. Though, if we're honest, Josh probably could've spent the whole trip carving up the mountain and been a happy camper.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Big horn sheep are one of North America’s most spectacular animals, but future conservation requires large-scale, hands-on efforts. Joining a multi-agency translocation in Texas, Dan Cabela is in the thick of it.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness. After serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish and speckled trout.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: Host Ryan McVinney takes Boat Trader fans on an indepth exploration of Florida flats fishing deep in the backcountry of Islamorada. Featuring Captain Eric Lund, a Wall Street Broker turned backcountry fishing guide, this episode reveals the key design features of the world’s best flats skiffs and how they are built for targeting some of the most exciting sportfish species on the planet. Also, covered are bay boats and their versatility for families exploring Florida’s coastal waterways, along with a detailed study of fish species and wildlife in the region. Some of the area’s most beautiful and secret locales show why Islamorada has earned the nickname of the Sportfish Capital of The World.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton makes a trip to South Carolina to fish Lake Murray. He meets up with the Rather Outdoors crew to spend time on the water and at the Rather HQ checking out all the gear from Lews and Strike King.

programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor chase Tarpon of all sizes around Florida Bay and the Everglades.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson head to Northern Maine to hunt for moose and learn about the conservation of this species which is under attack by winter ticks. Can reducing moose numbers be the key to saving the local moose population from this deadly parasite?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green is joined by his childhood friends in his home state of Michigan for a trout fishing adventure. They visit the most dynamic landmarks in the Upper Peninsula, do a little cliff jumping, and finish out the trip cooking trout riverside.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: About 2-3 months ago Mark purchased a 300+ acre farm in Kentucky. After running trail cameras and putting food plots on the farm, Mark now has the chance to get in the stand on opening day of Kentucky's bow season. There have been plenty of shooter bucks on the farm but only a few still are holding their velvet. Mark has his sights set on a Giant Kentucky Velvet Whitetail. The day before opening day Salt River puts on a celebration that features the @theswonbrothers.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Giant 15 Point Kansas Whitetail, Early Season Hunt"
programme.desc: It's 2016 and Mark heads down to Kansas for an early season Muzzleloader Whitetail hunt with Salt River Outfitters. It was hot in the stand with little deer movement until the moon phase switched and - one of the bucks Mark had been looking for stepped out. Kansas is one of those states that has an early Muzzleloader season that opens in September, and if you can get the weather and the moon to align you can catch a big deer on his feet in daylight.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he ventures into Croatia’s wild heart, hot on the trail of a legendary stag. In the midst of the rutting season’s deafening roars, tensions escalate as Mark closes the distance. - Equipped with his Gunwerks 7LRM, things get dicey as Mark is face to face with a roaring stag at 12 yards!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson on an epic hunting adventure in the stunning landscapes of New Zealand as he goes after Whitetail deer. On this hunt, Mark was unable to get his firearms import permit in time to take his Gunwerks rifle, so he'd have to borrow a trusty rifle from his guide, Shawn. Get ready for heart-pounding action, breathtaking scenery, and valuable tips and tricks from a seasoned hunter.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Waterfowl Hunting In Argentina, Is This A Dream!?-| , South America Waterfowl Slam"
programme.desc: It's May of 2022 and Mark Peterson is waterfowl hunting in Argentina. A year has passed since Mark conquered the North America Waterfowl Slam. During the off-season, and with Covid just a memory, his focus shifted to thoughts of South America and the waterfowl species that it holds. After a few months of research and talking with the experts at Worldwide Trophy Adventures, he laid out the plan to attempt the South America slam in 2022. With 20 species on the list, Mark is now hunting ducks below the equator as they migrate North to warmer weather. Enjoy this first installment of a 9 episode series that showcases his new quest for another single-season waterfowl slam.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.sub-title: "Hurricane Ian Aftermath With The Sanibel Fire Department"
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to Southwest Florida and connect with the Sanibel Fire Department to highlight and claim witness to the devastation left behind from Hurricane Ian. The magnitude and amount of destruction is hard to capture, but you'll see that the American spirit still shines through all the rubble. We also honor our next Scheels hometown hero, Rod Wilson!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors

programme.desc: Hunting has a way of grounding us, reminding us of what truly matters: shared moments and unforgettable memories. While the goal was a big buck, the true reward was the time spent together and the lessons learned along the way. Because hunting is about so much more than the harvest — it’s about the journey.
